Choose an oriented incidence matrix B_R for the inherited connected relational support. L_I^b(t)=B_R^T diag(w_e^b(t)) B_R. L_I is symmetric PSD, L_I 1=0, and on connected positive branches ker(L_I)=span{1}.

Use only the inherited Big-Implosion physical clock family t_phys=t_B tau_B, t_B>0; recurrence depth is never time. A monotone reparameterization changes coordinate representation but not the relational metric history.

For inherited positive radiative propagation speed v_gamma^b(t), define the branch causal conformal-reach functional chi_b(t1,t2)=integral_[t1,t2] v_gamma^b(u)/a_b(u) du. Finite relational distances are d_b(i,j;t); any later continuum/luminosity/angular-diameter correspondence requires a separately proved limit and is not assumed in I.

Required identities are M>=0, column sums=1, w>=0, sum_e w_e=sum_r Gamma_r, L=L^T>=0, L1=0, one gauge zero-mode on connected positive branches, resistance-metric symmetry/nonnegativity, and inherited charge/probability/conservation ledgers unchanged.
